<script lang="ts">
import type { Variants } from 'motion-v'
import type { IconProps } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'

export type Share2Props = IconProps<keyof typeof animations>;

export const animations = {
  default: {
    lines: {},
    path1: {},
    path2: {},
    node1: {
      initial: { scale: 1 },
      animate: {
        scale: [1, 1.25, 1],
        transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeInOut' },
      },
    },
    node2: {
      initial: { scale: 1 },
      animate: {
        scale: [1, 1.25, 1],
        transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeInOut', delay: 0.15 },
      },
    },
    node3: {
      initial: { scale: 1 },
      animate: {
        scale: [1, 1.25, 1],
        transition: { duration: 0.4, ease: 'easeInOut', delay: 0.3 },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
  spread: {
    lines: {},
    path1: {
      initial: { pathLength: 1, transition: { duration: 0.15 } },
      animate: {
        pathLength: [0, 1],
        transition: { duration: 0.35, delay: 0.08, ease: 'easeOut' },
      },
    },
    path2: {
      initial: { pathLength: 1, transition: { duration: 0.15 } },
      animate: {
        pathLength: [0, 1],
        transition: { duration: 0.35, delay: 0.08, ease: 'easeOut' },
      },
    },
    node1: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } },
      animate: {
        x: [0, 1, 0],
        y: [0, -1, 0],
        transition: { duration: 0.45, times: [0, 0.4, 1], ease: 'easeOut' },
      },
    },
    node2: {},
    node3: {
      initial: { x: 0, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.15 } },
      animate: {
        x: [0, 1, 0],
        y: [0, 1, 0],
        transition: { duration: 0.45, times: [0, 0.4, 1], ease: 'easeOut' },
      },
    },
  } satisfies Record<string, Variants>,
} as const;
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { IconWrapper } from '@animate-ui/vue/icons'
import { motion } from 'motion-v'

defineOptions({ name: 'Share2', inheritAttrs: false })
</script>
